sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict confirmed_exact: position confirmed at this residue. validation_level surface_only -> detected_only (paper reports surface: no, function: not_reported). Paper (PMID 41388024): "inserted into the LRRC8A extracellular loop, between residues 76 and 91, generating a construct for expression of mmLRRC8A(76-BRIL-91)". Audit note: Mouse LRRC8A (Q80WG5) residues 60-100 align to human with zero offset (mouse 76 is Ser, human 76 is Gly; 91 is Asp in both). BRIL replaces loop residues 77-90 rather than being inserted after 76, and the construct was expressed in Sf9 insect cells for cryo-EM only; no cell-surface display or function of the BRIL construct was measured (electrophysiology used untagged channels), so surface_only is unsupported.] L1 explicitly names residues 76 and 91 as the flanking junctions of the BRIL insertion in the extracellular loop of mmLRRC8A, placing the N-terminal junction at insert_after_residue=76. Python lookup confirms human LRRC8A residue 76 is G and residue 77 is P, both within ECL1 (49–123), 28 aa from TM1 and 48 aa from TM2 — well clear of both boundaries. The BRIL (~106 aa) is larger than the requested ALFA tag (~15–23 aa), so a shorter epitope tag at this same junction is well-supported by the demonstrated loop tolerance. The site is classified as indirect because the published insertion is in the mouse ortholog, but the loop is conserved and the residue numbering aligns. Full-length mmLRRC8A with BRIL inserted between residues 76 and 91 (replacing the native loop segment 77–90) expressed in Sf9 insect cells; construct used for cryo-EM structural determination of the hexameric VRAC channel. The paper explicitly names both flanking residues (76 and 91) of the insertion in the extracellular loop (ECL1, human topology 49–123). Mouse LRRC8A is a close ortholog; human residue 76 is G and 91 is D, both confirmed in ECL1.

sources.claim: The sequence for apocytochrome b562RIL (BRIL) 14 , 28 was then codon optimized for Spodoptera frugiperda and inserted into the LRRC8A extracellular loop, between residues 76 and 91, generating a construct for expression of mmLRRC8A(76-BRIL-91)-SNS-LEVLFQGP-SRGGSGAAAGSGSGS-sfGFP-GSS-7xHis (LRRC8A BRIL ).
